title: Archive the retired Hetzner/k3s tree (bootstrap/, gitops/prod) instead of warning about it
problem: The servers were deleted on 2026-10-01, but bootstrap/ (k3s and Argo install scripts) and gitops/prod still sit at the top level as if live. CLAUDE.md has to tell every run that 'manifests under gitops/prod describe that dead origin', a rule that exists only because the tree misleads. CAVEAT: filed from a one-pass repo-organization review (2026-10-16), not a measured study. The change is a first guess and may be oversimplified; check the evidence and the dependents before acting on it, and drop the item with a reason if it does not hold up.
evidence: CLAUDE.md 'Hosting: what is actually served': Hetzner route retired 2026-10-01; gitops/prod describes a dead origin
git grep on origin/main 2029d18f86 (2026-10-16): bootstrap/ is referenced from 3 workflows, .sops.yaml, README.md and gitops/agents/*; 51 files outside gitops/ mention gitops/prod
change: Check which references are live (gitops/prod/front-door-tools is still regenerated by platform/marketing/regen.mjs, so it is NOT dead and must not move without P014). Move only the cluster-specific parts (bootstrap/, hetzner-gitops-ci.yml, gitops/prod/host etc.) under an archive/ directory with a README, and update the references. If most references turn out live, drop this item.
metric: Top-level directories describing infrastructure that no longer exists; CLAUDE.md lines spent warning about them
source: Repo-organization review in a Claude Code session, 2026-10-16 (unmeasured; see CAVEAT in problem)
result: Dropped 2026-10-16: the references are live, as the item's own caveat anticipated. git grep on this checkout: bootstrap/ or gitops/prod is named by 17 files under gitops/tests (shellcheck coverage, manifests, restore_cluster, host governor, installers), 20 non-test files under platform/, 3 workflows (hetzner-gitops-ci, outage-triage, public-surface-check), .sops.yaml, infra/*.tf, gitops/root.yaml. gitops/prod also holds the regenerated front-door mirror (see P014). A move would rewrite ~40 files and their tests for a cosmetic gain; the CLAUDE.md warning paragraph is cheaper. Revisit only after P014 removes the mirror from gitops/prod. Done 2026-10-30 at the owner's request, by deletion rather than a move: infra/, bootstrap/ and gitops/ removed together with the front-door generators in platform/marketing/, public_surface.py and its workflow, host_routes_state.py and hetzner-gitops-ci.yml; publish_surface.py, sync_tree_counts.py, check.mjs, pages_state.py, venture-preflight.mjs and checklist_coverage.py edited to stop reading the trees. 55,114 lines deleted. Write-up: docs/posts/2026-10-30-deleting-a-dead-cluster.md.
history: 2026-10-30 owner asked to delete the retired trees; done
